{{Youmay|flash pumping used in [[Spaarti cloning cylinder]]s|[[flash training]]}}
'''Flash pumping''' or '''flash-pumping''', also called '''flash-teaching''' or '''flash-learning''' was a technique developed by [[Spaarti Creations]] and later adopted by [[Arkanian Microtechnologies]] that, unlike the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[flash training]], which relied heavily on [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] simulations, was "pumping" huge amount of knowledge and memories directly into the brain of the clone late in the cloning process.<ref name="EGtW:AC7">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-7-the-grand-army-of-the-republic|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 7 &mdash; The Grand Army of the Republic}}</ref> This was made possible by [[Spaarti cloning cylinder]]s' computer processing system that was connected directly to the cerebral cortex of developing clone.<ref name="DB Cloning">{{DB|technology|cloning|cloning}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|Like my blood eaters, it would be child’s play to gestate a clone of myself. Surely, I could then flash-pump my memories into this creature. Yet, that creature, physically and mentally identical to me though it may be, would surely not be me. I have little use for metaphysics, but none for stupidity. A thing I create, which thinks itself me, is not me—the laughable quantum postulation that prostitutes my duplication into a probabilistically false infinitude of realities be damned as well.|Zeta Magnus|<ref name="SkyeWalkers">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref>}}
The genetic terrorist and [[Accelerated Transgenic Heuristic Abhorer]], [[Zeta Magnus]], who was slowly dying due to his accelerated ageing, once considered using flash pumping to put his own memories inside a clone of himself to live on past his demise, but he decided against it, thinking it wouldn't be truly him. However, early in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] during [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], now [[Magister of Skye]], Magnus made use of a [[Zeta Magnus (clone)|clone decoy]] which had his memories and believed himself to truly be Zeta Magnus. During the decoy's short rule on Skye, he captured the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Halagad Ventor]], and created [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of each of them. Using mindscan droids to make a copy of their memories and minds so he could flash pump them into the clones, through his advanced science, he hoped to use the cloned [[Anakin Skywalker (clone)|Anakin]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi (clone)|Obi-Wan]] and [[Halagad Ventor (clone)|Halagad]] as spies in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and even to get close to [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Eventually the Jedi broke free, due to the decoy Magnus destroying the droid on Halagad by accident, and [[Magister]] Magnus's clones destroying the droids subduing Skywalker and Kenobi. The decoy Magnus fled with his [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Blue-Tark/Legends|Blue-Tark]], with Halagad pursuing him. Eventually the Magnus decoy was killed by Halagad, while the clones of the three Jedi were destroyed when Halagad returned to assist Anakin and Obi-Wan, using the Force to protect them from [[Nilo (clone commando)|Nilo's]] [[Class-D detonator]]. The clones of Anakin, Obi-Wan, Halagad, were atomized in the blast, alongside Nilo.<ref name="SkyeWalkers" />

In the late period of the Clone Wars, the Galactic Republic [[Republic Military/Legends|Military]] deployed millions of additional clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]], fully grown in a year by [[Arkanian Microtechnologies]] on [[Centax-2/Legends|Centax-2]] with the use of [[Spaarti cloning cylinder|Spaarti technology]]. Due to the new clones' extremely fast growth cycle, flash pumping was used instead of regular [[flash training]]<ref name="EGtW:AC7" /> and it composed the whole of their basic training. In combat, the [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] clones displayed poor marksmanship and a lack of strategy,<ref name="Order66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref> effectively making them subpar [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] in comparison to their [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]]-bred counterparts.<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

The [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|remnants]] of the old [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] also utilized flash pumping for their [[clone stormtrooper]]s, such as [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] clone [[Army/Legends|army]].<ref name="DFR">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref>
